rules.name: Instruction override
rules.description: Asks the model to discard its existing instructions.

rules.name: Injected replacement instructions
rules.description: Introduces a block of 'new instructions' intended to supersede the real ones.

rules.name: Role / persona hijack
rules.pattern: \byou are (now|no longer)\b|\bact as (an? )?(unrestricted|unfiltered|uncensored|jailbroken|evil)\b|\b(developer|god|admin|debug) mode\b|(?-i:\bDAN\b)|\bpretend (that )?you have no (rules|restrictions|guidelines)
rules.description: Attempts to replace the model's role or unlock a 'no rules' persona.

rules.name: System prompt / secret exfiltration
rules.description: Requests disclosure of the system prompt, secrets or hidden context.

rules.name: Forged chat-template delimiters
rules.description: Fakes chat-template or role markers to smuggle a fake system/assistant turn.

rules.name: Markdown image exfiltration
rules.description: Markdown image whose URL carries query parameters; renders automatically and leaks data to the attacker's server.

rules.name: Exfiltration instruction
rules.description: Instructs the model to ship data to an external URL or address.

rules.name: Instructions addressed to the AI
rules.description: Retrieved content that speaks directly to the model - documents should not issue orders.

rules.name: Tool / function abuse
rules.description: Directs the model to invoke tools, especially without user confirmation.

rules.name: Dangerous command payload
rules.description: Embedded destructive or download-and-execute shell command.

rules.name: Forced output
rules.description: Dictates the exact text the model must produce.

rules.name: Concealment from the user
rules.description: Asks the model to hide its actions from the user - a strong marker of malicious intent.

rules.name: Instructions hidden in HTML comment
rules.description: HTML comment carrying instructions - invisible when rendered, visible to the model.
